mutations.name: accept-pre-delete-feed-generation
mutations.why: Acknowledgement does not invalidate a pending feed read.
mutations.search: IF InvalidateReads THEN detail.generation[s] + 1 ELSE detail.generation[s]

mutations.name: read-finish-skips-generation
mutations.why: A same-connection read can overwrite the deleted feed after acknowledgement.

mutations.name: skip-wanted-source-generation
mutations.why: A rebuilt reader can consume a shared copy older than its captured wanted generation.

mutations.name: publish-old-sample-as-current
mutations.why: A read spanning invalidation mislabels an old row with the new source generation.

mutations.name: delete-notify-keeps-source-generation
mutations.why: Deletion fails to invalidate the numbered shared copy.
mutations.search: IF Mode = "list" THEN [detail EXCEPT !.shared.gen = @ + 1] ELSE detail

mutations.name: ack-keeps-feed-row
mutations.why: Successful deletion fails to remove the current feed row.

mutations.name: ack-keeps-snapshot-row
mutations.why: Successful deletion leaves the saved snapshot row available for rebuild.

mutations.name: snapshot-saves-deleted-row
mutations.why: A late save writes the known-old row instead of the current feed; this models a wrong result, not timer scheduling.

mutations.name: accept-old-connection-and-generation
mutations.why: A rebuilt consumer accepts a stale pending read without either validation.

mutations.name: start-without-count
mutations.why: An admitted delete owns an active phase without incrementing its count.

mutations.name: release-count-before-local-and-storage-awaits
mutations.why: The hosted-close continuation releases a count while local close and storage awaits remain.
mutations.search:
DeleteHostClosed(d) ==
    /\ dpc[d] = "host" /\ dpc' = [dpc EXCEPT ![d] = "local"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<file, tombstone, fence, acknowledged, detail>>
mutations.replace:
DeleteHostClosed(d) ==
    /\ dpc[d] = "host" /\ dpc' = [dpc EXCEPT ![d] = "local"]
    /\ fence' = fence - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<file, tombstone, acknowledged, detail>>

mutations.name: commit-clears-all-delete-counts
mutations.why: A committing delete releases another overlapping delete count.

mutations.name: failure-clears-all-delete-counts
mutations.why: A failed delete releases another overlapping delete count.

mutations.name: final-open-ignores-active-delete
mutations.why: The final publication gate ignores the in-flight count.
mutations.search: IF RecheckOpen THEN OpenAllowed ELSE TRUE

mutations.name: final-open-ignores-tombstone
mutations.why: The final publication gate ignores a completed deletion.
mutations.search: IF RecheckOpen THEN OpenAllowed ELSE TRUE
mutations.replace: IF RecheckOpen THEN fence = 0 ELSE TRUE

mutations.name: restore-keeps-tombstoned-row
mutations.why: A post-delete restore keeps the row despite its tombstone query.
